Application Materials.content:
- An updated Resume
- Your official academic transcripts of all educational institutions attended.
- 2 Personal Statements
- Explain in 500-600 words your career and personal aspirations, and your motivation for pursuing the SMU programme(s) that you have applied to
- Discuss in 500 - 600 words one of the following topics:
- Describe your greatest weakness and how you have tried to overcome it.
- Describe your outstanding talents, skills and inherent abilities that are not reflected in your academic qualifications and records.
- Describe the situation with greatest ethical complexity that you have faced in your professional or academic life, and how your input helped resolved it.
- 2 Referee Reports: Submit 2 complete sets of referee details during the online process of applying for the SMU MIM. The application portal will automatically send an email to your referees and collect your recommendation forms on your behalf once you have submitted the application.
- Copy of NRIC/FIN/Passport (in PDF or JPEG format)
- Any other supporting documents
- Verification of original documents is required upon matriculation into the programme. Failing to do so may result in applicants having to withdraw from the programme.
- Leadership Potential scholarship essay: “Please explain in 500 words why you consider yourself a leader"
- Community Impact Award essay: “Please share an example of how you have impacted your greater community and what you think is the best way to serve society."
- Impact on Asia essay: “Please explain in 500 words the professional development, entrepreneurial or personal projects of an Asian focus that have contributed positively to Asian regions or companies or have increased awareness of Asia in other locations."
- Women in Business Scholarship essay: “Please explain in 500 words why you should be awarded the Women in Business Scholarship”.
- AGL Irudayaraj Scholarship essay: “Please describe in 500 words why you should receive the AGL Irudayaraj Scholarship. You should elaborate on your leadership experience, community involvement and financial need, if any."

Interview Requirements.content:
At Singapore Management University (SMU), the interview is more than just an evaluation exercise. It is an opportunity for the admissions committee to understand your motivations, experiences, communication style, and how you may contribute to the classroom experience and broader SMU community. Whether you are applying for programmes in Management, Finance, Business Analytics, Economics, Accounting, or other postgraduate disciplines, preparation and authenticity go a long way.
- The admissions panel is often looking at qualities such as clarity of career goals and motivations, communication and articulation skills, self-awareness and maturity, curiosity and willingness to learn, ability to contribute to peer learning discussions, business awareness and critical thinking, and alignment between your aspirations and the programme.
- One of the most common interview questions is: “Why are you interested in this programme?” Strong candidates should explain what specific skills or exposure they hope to gain, why this programme fits their career trajectory, and why this is the right stage in their career to pursue postgraduate studies.
- Interviewers may ask broader or unexpected questions such as: “Tell us about a challenge you faced and how you handled it,” “What are some trends currently impacting your industry?”, “What is a recent business issue or news topic that caught your attention?”, “What do you think you can contribute to the classroom?”, “How do you handle disagreements within a team?”, and “What would success look like for you after graduation?”
- For candidates applying to more technical programmes, there may also be questions related to quantitative readiness, coding exposure, analytical thinking, and problem-solving approaches.
- The best interviews often feel less like an interrogation and more like a meaningful conversation. It is fine to pause briefly to gather your thoughts, ask clarifying questions, admit areas where you are still learning, and reflect honestly on your experiences.
- The interview process helps ensure that students not only benefit from the experience but also contribute meaningfully to the learning journey of others. The interview is also an opportunity to evaluate whether the programme aligns with your own goals and aspirations.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **Good undergraduate degree.**
- All candidates from local autonomous universities (NUS, NTU, SUTD, SIT, and SUSS/SIM) can apply with an undergraduate GPA that meets the programme’s requirements.
- Candidates from local autonomous universities with a **GPA under 3.5** will need to demonstrate some other academic quality score.
- An undergraduate GPA is valid for **5 years after graduation**.
- SMU will accept good undergraduate GPAs from SMU in place of the admissions test requirement.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- MIM项目申请条件包括：良好的 GMAT/GMAT FOCUS/GRE/SMU 入学考试成绩。
- **特别注意：**SMU 本科毕业生可以以良好本科 GPA（**3.4/4.0及以上**）代替 SMU 入学考试。
- 新加坡本地自主大学（新加坡国立大学、南洋理工大学、新加坡科技设计大学、新加坡理工大学、新加坡新跃社科大学和新加坡管理学院）的本科毕业生可以以良好本科 GPA（**3.5/4.0及以上**）代替 SMU 入学考试。
- 本科毕业于 SMU 和新加坡本地自主大学的申请人，如果GPA低于以上要求，还需要提供其他学术证明（如GMAT、GMAT FOCU、GRE、SMU入学考试）。
- 本科GPA在毕业后五年内有效。
- 申请资料包括：良好的 GMAT/GMAT FOCUS/GRE/SMU 入学考试成绩。
- 如果申请人尚未参加 SMU 入学考试、GMAT、GMAT FOCU或 GRE 考试，申请人可以先提交在线申请，并尽快安排考试。

English Proficiency Requirements.content: TOEFL / IELTS (Waived if English was the medium of instruction for your undergraduate studies.)

Program Overview.content:
The SMU Master of Science in Management (MIM) programme is designed for individuals with no prior business experience to transit successfully to the world of business. With a comprehensive curriculum that covers the latest business trends, this programme offers a broad but rigorous education in business management.
The programme is a full-time, 18-month programme with two intakes per year, one in January and one in August. It is intended to appeal to students with limited or no previous business experience who are seeking a well-rounded orientation to business management. Students will develop business and management skills, enhance employment versatility in the workplace and possess the knowledge needed to be successful in today’s global environment. The programme is also suitable for those who intend to start their own businesses in the future as it covers all aspects of managing a business enterprise.
Programme highlights include practical experience through internships, immersive case studies, SMU-X Overseas and exchange programs with partner universities including London Business School in the UK and IE Business School in Spain. The syllabus integrates areas such as AI, digital transformation, sustainability, strategic problem-solving, leadership, business acumen, guest lectures from industry leaders, professional development workshops and career coaching.
Master of Science in Management (MiM) Class Profile:
- Average Age: 25
- Students: 147
- International Students: 92%
- Nationalities: 18
The programme structure includes 8 Core Modules, elective modules, an SMU-XO course, internship, and Postgraduate Professional Development Workshop. Programme highlights include:
- Internship: The internship lasts a minimum of 10 weeks and provides students with opportunities across a wide range of companies, varying in size and industry, with a monthly stipend ranging from S$1,200 to S$2,000.
- SMU-XO: SMU-X Overseas (SMU-XO) project focuses on business challenges outside Singapore. Learn more [here](https://x.smu.edu.sg/about/what-is-smu-x-overseas).
- SMU-X: SMU-X elective courses emphasize experiential and holistic learning through hands-on projects aimed at applying concepts from the classroom to solve real business issues and problems.
There are optional concentration tracks for the elective portion of the MIM programme: Marketing, Finance, Operations Management and Sustainability. Students are required to choose tracks by the end of Term 2 if they pursue a concentration. Each student may elect one concentration area; it will not reflect on the degree scroll but will be noted on the transcript.
SMU has earned accreditation from AACSB International (AACSB) for both its business and accounting undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. SMU is also one of the few Asian universities to receive a five-year EQUIS accreditation.
Career counselling and workshops will be provided to MIM students and attendance is compulsory. MIM students have access to a career counsellor who will assist on post-graduation placement through guidance and advice. The internship component is expected to improve employability by providing opportunities for early exposure to the work environment of Singapore.
SMU MIM graduates are able to explore options in different business functions such as logistics, shipping, marketing, sales and finance. Graduates can also continue to work in specialised fields such as law, architecture and engineering and complement their professions with a better understanding of how a business operates.
Our MiM graduates are hired across a wide range of industries, including Technology (23%), Audit/Accounting (14%), Financial Services (13%), Retail/Wholesale (7%), Manufacturing (7%), Consumer/Luxury Goods (5%), Transportation/Logistics (5%) and Others (26%). Over 60% of MiM graduates are involved in job functions such as Finance/Accounting, Marketing/Sales and General Management: Finance/Accounting (28%), Marketing/Sales (25%), General Management (14%), Operations (9%), Consulting (9%) and Others (15%).

Curriculum.content:
The MiM programme has two intakes every year, in January and Aug. Their respective structures are as below:
| Intake | Period 1 | Period 2 | Period 3 | Period 4 | Period 5 | Period 6 | Period 7 | Period 8 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **JAN INTAKE** | Jan - Mar: 4 Core Modules | Apr - Jun: 4 Core Modules; Open Modules | Jul: PGPD* workshop | Aug - Nov: 4 Electives | Nov - Dec: PGPD* workshop / Business Study Mission | Jan - Apr: Immersion** | Jun: Graduation | |
| **AUG INTAKE** | Aug - Nov: 4 Core Modules | Nov - Dec: PGPD* workshop; Open Modules | Jan - Mar: 4 Core Modules | Apr - Jun: Immersion** | Jul: PGPD* workshop | Aug - Nov: 4 Electives | Nov - Dec: Business Study Mission | Jan: Graduation |
*PGPD = Postgraduate Professional Development. **Immersion = Internship and Consulting Project.**
The programme curriculum consists of **16 Credit Units (CU)**: Postgraduate Professional Development course (1 CU) + Programme Core (8 CU) + Track Electives (4 CU) + Immersion (1 CU) + Open Modules (2 CU).
Programme highlights include:
- **Internship:** Meld academic concepts with actual business situations and put knowledge into practice with a **minimum 10-week internship** depending on employer requirements.
- **Consulting Project:** Apply academic theories to tackle business challenges with a real business client. Designed based on SMU-X pedagogy, the Project is a project-based learning experience.
- **Global Exposure:** Experience ASEAN countries through company visits and the Business Study Mission, or pursue electives in partner schools in the global MiM network comprising London Business School or Imperial College Business School in the United Kingdom, ESMT Berlin in Germany, and Smith School of Business at Queen’s University in Canada.
8 Core Modules:
- MKTG618 Marketing
- ECON672 Global Economics
- OBHR624 Managing People & Organizations
- ACCT647 Accounting
- OPIM617 Operations & Supply Chain Management
- OPIM628 Business Analytics
- MGMT672 Strategy
- FNCE680 Corporate Finance
Elective Modules: Students choose **4 from 22** elective modules, from Common Elective Modules and Track-Specific Elective Modules. Track-Specific Elective Modules are for students who would like to do a concentration in Finance, Operations Management, Marketing, or Sustainability by taking 4 elective courses to specialise in a single track.
Common Elective Modules:
- COMM662 Management Communication
- MGMT696 Design Thinking & Creativity
- OBHR617 Negotiating in Business
- MGMT6027 Communicating Across Cultures
- MGMT687 Business Study Mission
Finance Track Elective Modules, choose any 4 courses being offered:
- FNCE6035 Equity Analysis and Portfolio Management
- FNCE699 Financial Markets
- FNCE6037 Investment Banking
- FNCE6034 Advanced Corporate Finance
- FNCE6045 Sustainable Finance
Operations Management Track Elective Modules, choose any 4 courses being offered:
- OPIM618 Decision Analytics
- OPIM630 Risk Management: Building Resilient Supply Chains
- OPIM633 Online Business and Marketplaces
- OPIM632 Sustainable Operations
- OPIM629 Successful Project Management
Marketing Track Elective Modules, choose any 4 courses being offered:
- MKTG625 Consumer Behaviour
- MKTG640 Behavioural Science in Marketing
- MKTG624 Marketing Analytics (SMU-X)
- MKTG628 Digital Marketing (SMU-X)
- MKTG637 Marketing Research
- MKTG641 Marketing in a Sustainable World
Sustainability Track Elective modules, choose any 4 courses being offered:
- MGMT6026 Entrepreneurship and Intrapreneurship
- FNCE6045 Sustainable Finance
- OPIM632 Sustainable Operations
- MGMT6017 Sustainable Impact
- MKTG641 Marketing in a Sustainable World

Cost of Attendance.content:
Living expenses will vary depending on your lifestyle and accommodation. However, the average international student would be able to stay within a monthly budget of S$2000 - with change to spare. Estimated breakdown of basic living expenses:
| Item | Cost Per Month |
| --- | --- |
| **Accommodation** | **S$250 - S$800** |
| **Utilities** | **S$40 - S$100** |
| **Transportation** | **S$200** |
| **Telecommunications** | **S$50** |
| **Books & Stationery** | **S$200 per term** |
| **Personal Expenses (mobile phone, meals, etc)** | **S$100 - S$300** |
| **Food** | **S$300 - S$450** |

Financial Aid.content:
Students may apply for our SMU MiM Programme Scholarships upon admission. These Scholarships entail award amounts up to 30% of the tuition fee, with no bonds attached.
Scholarships include: AGL Irudayaraj Scholarship, Academic Excellence, Global Awareness, Leadership Potential, Community Impact, Impact on Asia, and Women in Business. Scholarships denoted with * are scholarships that students can apply for upon admissions into the programme.
- **AGL Irudayaraj Scholarship**: motivates outstanding postgraduates of Indian ethnicity at the University to greater heights of academic excellence. The Admissions Scholarship Committee will assess interview performance and an essay: “Please describe in 500 words why you should receive the AGL Irudayaraj Scholarship. You should elaborate on your leadership experience, community involvement and financial need, if any."
- **Ayala Postgraduate Scholarship**: valued at S$25 000, for outstanding candidates from the Philippines pursuing postgraduate education. The Admissions Scholarship Committee will assess outstanding and deserving candidates from the Philippines; full-time/part-time students matriculated to the MBA or MiM Programme; and special consideration will be given to those who demonstrate financial need.
- **Academic Excellence**: offered to high-quality candidates with exceptional academic performance. Awards are based on academic merit, final grades and GMAT score. Tier One awardees must have achieved a GMAT of 700 or above; Tier Two awardees must have achieved a GMAT of 680 or above.
- **Global Awareness**: given to individuals who will contribute to the classroom diversity and enrich the learning experience of students by way of cultural, personal or professional backgrounds.
- **Leadership Potential**: recognises individuals with strong leadership potential who have exhibited outstanding leadership potential during their studies, community or organization. Applicants must demonstrate strong leadership potential in personal and professional instances.
- **Community Impact Award**: recognises candidates who have contributed to society through outstanding community work and have impacted members of the community/society in a positive manner.
- **Impact on Asia**: for students who can demonstrate achievements in their professional, social and personal life that have created an impact on Asia.
- **Women in Business Award**: recognises exceptional women who have demonstrated outstanding leadership capabilities or potential in their professional or personal endeavours. Applicants must have successfully received an admissions offer.
**Alumni Discount**: Graduates from SMU undergraduate or postgraduate programmes are automatically eligible for an alumni discount when applying to the MiM programme.

Multiple Applications.content: If you have applied for more than one programme, you are only required to take the test once. Please contact your first-choice’s programme office to register for the test and update the other programme office upon the completion of your test via email to ensure timely processing of all your SMU applications.
